headers.//: STATIC FILES CACHE IN THE BROWSER, because every re-fetch of an unchanged stylesheet is a billable edge request. Each page pulls five css/js files plus its html; without this a returning visitor pays for all six again. An hour is deliberately modest: these filenames carry no content hash, so a long max-age would serve stale script against fresh html after a deploy. An hour bounds that while still collapsing the repeat visits that make up most of the traffic.
Pictures do not change without changing their name, and the og images are only ever fetched by link scrapers. A week costs nothing and saves every repeat.
